name: Frozen Ectoplasm
summary: Mux Manascrambler needs Frozen Ectoplasm from Winterspring’s restless Highborne spirits. It is one of three spectral substances he seeks for his work with the dead.

sections.title: Winter Spirits
sections.body: Near Winterspring’s lake, Anguished and Suffering Highborne leave Frozen Ectoplasm behind. Mux Manascrambler asks you to gather it with an Ectoplasmic Distiller, alongside Scorched Ectoplasm from Silithus and Stable Ectoplasm from the Eastern Plaguelands. He hopes the three substances will let him reach souls that have not wholly left this world.

faq.q: Where do I find Frozen Ectoplasm?
faq.answer: Anguished and Suffering Highborne near the lake in Winterspring leave Frozen Ectoplasm behind.
Mux Manascrambler needs it for Hunting for Ectoplasm, which calls for three kinds of ectoplasm gathered with an Ectoplasmic Distiller.
Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan wants Frozen Ectoplasm, along with Scorched and Stable Ectoplasm.
Mux hopes to use the otherworldly energies in the ectoplasm to reach souls that have not wholly left this world.
The Anguished and Suffering Highborne spirits of Winterspring leave Frozen Ectoplasm.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize Mux’s Ectoplasmic Distiller as his device for gathering spectral substances.
